title: Cairn Wellness: slow rituals for the season
preheaderText: New teas, river stones, and hand-poured candles. Small rituals for slower mornings, shipped from the coast.
heroImageAlt: Stacked river stones on a linen cloth
heroText: Small rituals for slower mornings. Loose teas, hand-poured candles, and river stones, shipped from the coast.
col1Text: Single-origin leaves, cut for slow steeping. Sixteen blends, none of them in a hurry.
col2Text: Smoothed granite and basalt, sorted by weight. Balance them on a shelf or hold one in your hand.
artAText: Beeswax and cedar, burned clean for forty hours. Poured in small runs, never rushed.
ctaText: Take the slow route. Twenty percent off your first order, this week only.
artBText: Soapstone figures, each one a little different. Sized for a windowsill.
artCText: Wool throws and low light. Everything you need to sit still for an hour.
artDText: A tea, a candle, and a stone, boxed in kraft paper. Ready to send.
